# [M] tpm2 does not detect if quote was not generated by TPM

## Summary
Severity: Medium
Advisory: CVE-2024-29038
Aliases: GHSA-5495-c38w-gr6f
CVSS: 4.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:N/A:N)
Published: 2024-06-28
Source: https://osv.dev/vulnerability/CVE-2024-29038
Type: osv

## Details
tpm2-tools is the source repository for the Trusted Platform Module (TPM2.0) tools. A malicious attacker can generate arbitrary quote data which is not detected by `tpm2 checkquote`. This issue was patched in version 5.7.
